PS3:of-orcs-and-men.d: Of Orcs and Men is a fantasy action role-playing game developed by Cyanide and Spiders for PlayStation 3, Xbox 360 and PC. The Empire of Men's oppressive threat looms over the territories of the Orcs and the Goblins. Goblins are systematically persecuted and slaughtered, while Orcs not killed in battle are captured and enslaved. Three prequels, titled Styx: Master of Shadows (2014), Styx: Shards of Darkness (2017), and Styx: Blades of Greed (2026) came out with Styx the goblin as the main protagonist.

PS5:endling-extinction-is-forever.d: Endling: Extinction is Forever is an indie survival-adventure game about the last mother fox and her cubs in a post-apocalyptic world. Developed by Barcelona-based studio Herobeat Studios and published by German HandyGames, it was first released for Microsoft Windows, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One on July 19, 2022. Subsequently, it was released for Amazon Luna on October 6, 2022, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 3, 2022, and for Android and iOS on February 7, 2023. The game was offered to PlayStation Plus subscribers, at no cost, for the month of July 2023.

XOne:spongebob-squarepants-battle-for-bi.d: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom – Rehydrated is a 2020 platform game developed by Purple Lamp Studios and published by THQ Nordic. Based on the Nickelodeon animated series SpongeBob SquarePants, it is a remake of the console versions of Heavy Iron Studios' SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom (2003). Development for Rehydrated began as early as January 2018, when THQ Nordic enlisted Purple Lamp Games as one of their developers. In March 2018, THQ Nordic announced plans to remake games based on Nickelodeon properties.

GEN:aerobiz.d: Aerobiz is a business simulation video game for the Super NES and Mega Drive/Genesis game consoles, released in 1992 by Koei. It was also released for the FM Towns, PC-9801 and X68000 computer platforms in Japan. As CEO of a budding international airline, the player has a limited amount of time to expand their business to become the industry leader against three other airlines (either AI-controlled or human opponents).
